name: Meñli I Giray
contribution: Thrice the khan of the Crimean Khanate and the sixth son of Hacı I Giray.

checks.lead: Meñli I Giray (1445–1515) was thrice the khan of the Crimean Khanate (1466, 1469–1475, 1478–1515) and the sixth son of Hacı I Giray.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
